conditions.description: Dense retriever returns top-k directly; no second stage.
conditions.label: dense-only
conditions.name: dense_only

conditions.description: Dense candidate pool is filtered once, then every candidate is scored by the same local cross-encoder before top-k truncation.
conditions.label: dense candidate pool + cross-encoder reranking
conditions.name: dense_reranked

conditions.description: BM25 retriever returns top-k directly; no second stage.
conditions.label: BM25-only
conditions.name: bm25_only

conditions.description: Equal-width dense and BM25 pools are filtered, deduplicated, fused with RRF, and truncated to top-k.
conditions.label: hybrid without reranking
conditions.name: hybrid_no_rerank

conditions.description: The same hybrid union is passed in full to the local cross-encoder; only then is it truncated to top-k.
conditions.label: hybrid + cross-encoder reranking
conditions.name: hybrid_reranked

metrics.module: module3.evaluation when available; stdlib-compatible fallback otherwise
